messages:
Maya Chen: Quick sync — launching a small experiment next week to test a simplified pricing page. Goal: reduce confusion around 'Committed vs Metered' and capture webinar signups. Plan: 2 variants — Crosswalk (old->new) + Calculator inline + Webinar CTA; and Compact tiers + FAQ accordion + Webinar CTA. Thoughts? :thinking_face:
Jeremy Patel: Love it. Can we add an inbound routing rule so leads from variant A go to SDRs trained on committed offers?
Liz Morales: Yes — we should tag leads with `pricing_variant:A` and `webinar:pm` so CS can route.
Maya Chen: Good call. I'll add to the routing matrix. Also thinking of a tiny copy change on CTA: 'Compare plans & join webinar' vs 'Estimate your monthly cost + RSVP'. Which drives clicks?
Samir K.: KPI: CTR -> signup -> qualified lead. Set up event bridge + GA event for both CTAs. I'll wire the events.
Anna (marketing): I'll draft the microsurvey that pops after 10s on page for non-clickers — 2 questions max.
Maya Chen: Drafts in the doc: https://docs.redwood.ai/pricing-crosswalk-experiment (please add comments). Figma frames: https://figma.com/file/xyz
Jeremy Patel: For A/B targeting, use 50/50 randomize by session id. Also make sure experiment length >= 7 days and traffic >= 200 uniques/day.
Samir K.: Quick check — calculator variant needs to support both token-based and committed pricing. Example snippet for inputs:
```
{ "requests_per_month": 1200000, "avg_tokens_per_request": 300 }
```
Samir K.: Output should show monthly cost for Hosted / Dedicated / Private and recommended route.
Liz Morales: For FAQ updates, let's add one about "How do I estimate monthly bill?" and "What makes Dedicated cheaper per-token?" Short answers.
Maya Chen: Webinar hook: 30-min demo + case study. Landing form minimal (email, company, use-case). Add calendar RSVP + add to nurture sequence.
Anna (marketing): I'll write two header lines for testing: 1) 'Predictable pricing. No surprises.' 2) 'Estimate costs in 30s, join live Q&A.' Which reads better?
Jeremy Patel: My pick 2. More action-oriented.
Maya Chen: Action items:
- Anna: header + microsurvey (due Wed)
- Samir: events & calc wiring (due Thu)
- Liz: FAQ copy + routing matrix (due Fri)
- Jeremy: A/B infra and gating (due Thu)
Maya Chen: Anyone want to join quick 15-min sync tomorrow 10am? @Samir K. @Liz Morales
Anna (marketing): I'll be there. :+1:
Samir K.: I'll join.
Liz Morales: Same. I'll bring routing table draft.
Maya Chen: Thanks all. Will post updated doc after the sync. :rocket:
